   Vacuum cleaners remaining = x - (1/3)x - 592
   Vacuum cleaners remaining = (2/3)x - 592

   Number of vacuum cleaners sold at the orange house = (1/2) * [(2/3)x - 592]

New value of electronics = $655 + $524 = $1179

$L_t = L_0 - 166816$  (Equation 2)
